# GUI Interface Description

## Top Bar
- **Left Side**:
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" application icon with a dropdown menu
- **Center**:
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:22"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Right Side**:
  - System status icons including:
    - Network connectivity
    - Sound/volume control
    - Power button

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application overview

## Main Window Content

### Terminal Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Search icon
  - Menu button (three horizontal lines)
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor at end of prompt

### File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - "Home" with house icon
  - Search icon
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)
- **Navigation Panel (Left Side)**:
  - "Recent" with clock icon
  - "Starred" with star icon
  - "Home" with house icon (currently selected)
  - "Desktop" with folder icon
  - "Documents" with document icon
  - "Downloads" with download icon
  - "Music" with music note icon
  - "Pictures" with image icon
  - "Videos" with video camera icon
  - "Trash" with trash can icon
  - "Other Locations" with plus icon
- **File List (Right Side)**:
  - **Top Row**:
    - Desktop folder
    - Documents folder
    - Downloads folder
    - Music folder
    - Pictures folder
    - Public folder
    - requirement.txt file
  - **Second Row**:
    - server folder
    - snap folder
    - Templates folder
    - Videos folder
    - .bash_history file
    - .bash_logout file
    - .bashrc file
  - **Third Row**:
    - .cache folder
    - .config folder
    - .gnupg folder
    - .ipython folder
    - .lessht file
    - .local folder
    - .mozilla folder
    - .var folder
  - **Fourth Row**:
    - .pki folder
    - .profile file
    - .selected_editor file
    - .ssh folder
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful file
    - thunderbird folder
  - **Fifth Row**:
    - .viminfo file
    - .vscode folder

## Context Menu
- **Location**: Appears above the "Files" application icon in the top bar
- **Options**:
  - "New Window"
  - "Quit"

## Desktop Background
- Geometric abstract design with purple and red gradients
- "Home" folder icon located at bottom right corner of the screen
